reply.critique: The five selections match the requested disciplines and geographic union. Princeton offers a fee-free paid commission; Smack Mellon offers a stipend; Artist Vault is fee-free and broadly eligible. DiP directly serves both selected disciplines, with a clear deadline, while the final free exhibition is explicitly identified as a donation rather than artist pay. HERALBONY has an unestablished disability eligibility requirement; many alternatives charge fees or lack actionable terms. No clearly better broadly applicable candidate is omitted.
